projects.title: Angkot To School (DISHUB Kota Bandung)
projects.summary: Real-time public transit tracking and safe route recommendation system for primary and secondary students across Bandung.
projects.coverAlt: Angkot To School public transit tracking dashboard preview
projects.problem: Public minibuses (Angkot) in Bandung lacked predictable scheduling and live tracking, causing parent anxiety, erratic student commute times, and inefficient route dispatch for municipal transport authorities.
projects.solution: Engineered an end-to-end telematics gateway utilizing high-frequency GPS telemetry, low-latency WebSockets, Leaflet.js real-time map clustering, and automated geofencing notifications alerting parents when vehicles approach school zones.
projects.result: Formally adopted by DISHUB Kota Bandung across 14 high-volume school routes. Successfully reduced average student waiting times by 34% and serves over 12,400 active student passengers every school morning.
projects.seoTitle: Angkot To School — Municipal Transit Tracking Case Study
projects.seoDescription: Case study on building real-time GPS fleet tracking and student safety geofencing with React, Leaflet, and Node.js for Dishub Kota Bandung.

projects.title: Smart Parking IoT System
projects.summary: Automated barrier control and slot occupancy sensor dashboard using ESP32 edge telemetry and cloud state sync.
projects.coverAlt: Smart Parking IoT System occupancy monitoring console
projects.problem: Commercial multi-tier parking complexes suffered from severe ingress congestion due to uncoordinated manual ticket gates and absent live vacancy indications per parking bay level.
projects.solution: Architected ultrasonic wireless sensor clusters on custom ESP32 microcontrollers communicating over MQTT to Supabase Realtime, integrated with an automatic license-plate gate actuator and live floor occupancy LED signs.
projects.result: Cut median vehicle search times from 9.2 minutes to 3.1 minutes (66% improvement) across 450 bays, while saving 18% in facility lighting power consumption through dynamic bay sensors.
projects.seoTitle: Smart Parking IoT System — ESP32 & Supabase Realtime Architecture
projects.seoDescription: Automated smart parking infrastructure utilizing ESP32 firmware, MQTT, and Supabase Realtime dashboards.

projects.title: Threadibility
projects.summary: Chrome extension and web service for accessible multi-thread discussion parsing and semantic tree visualization.
projects.problem: Deeply nested forum discussions and GitHub issue comments are challenging for screen readers and keyboard-only power users to navigate cleanly without getting lost in branches.
projects.solution: Created a client-side tree parser extension that flattens conversations into an accessible semantic outline with instant keyboard shortcuts, speaker sentiment categorization, and branch collapsing.
projects.result: Grew to over 4,500 active weekly developers on the Chrome Web Store, earning a 4.9/5 average rating and an Accessibility Excellence award.
projects.seoTitle: Threadibility — Accessible Forum Discussion Parsing Extension
projects.seoDescription: Chrome extension and web app providing accessible tree outlines for developer discussions and forums.

projects.title: Wawasan Bela Negara Quiz
projects.summary: Gamified educational assessment platform with adaptive question difficulty and real-time national leaderboard.
projects.coverAlt: Wawasan Bela Negara Quiz gamified UI
projects.problem: Traditional civic education tests suffered from low student engagement and lack of interactive formative feedback.
projects.solution: Built a timed, interactive quiz app with animated progression bars, score multiplication streaks, and anti-cheat session validation.
projects.result: Engaged over 28,000 student quiz sessions in its first 3 months with 91% completion rates.

projects.title: Jabar Logistics Fleet Dispatch
projects.summary: Centralized route optimization and delivery dispatch console handling multi-stop regional freight distribution.
projects.problem: Regional couriers faced high fuel overheads due to manual static route planning across mountainous West Java regions.
projects.solution: Engineered an automated traveling-salesperson route grouping microservice in Go, backed by Redis geo-spatial caches and async queue workers.
projects.result: Decreased average route mileage by 19% across 80 delivery vans operating out of 4 hub centers.

projects.title: EcoSense Environmental Telemetry
projects.summary: Solar-powered environmental monitoring station array streaming air quality, humidity, and temperature data.
projects.problem: Micro-climate variations in highland agricultural plots required frequent localized humidity and particulate readings without reliable cellular wall power.
projects.solution: Built solar-powered ESP32 nodes sleeping at 15uA, waking every 15 minutes to sample PMS5003 and BME280 sensors before beaming payloads via LoRaWAN/MQTT.
projects.result: Deployed 12 autonomous stations running non-stop for 18 months without battery replacement.

profile.name: Rangga Prasetya
profile.headline: Fullstack Developer
profile.bio: Fullstack developer with a passion for high-performance web applications, IoT integration, and human-centered user experiences based in Bandung, Indonesia. Over 3 years building reliable software solutions spanning municipal smart city platforms, edge IoT systems, and high-speed web apps.

experiences.description: Architecting distributed transit telematics (Angkot To School) for Dishub Kota Bandung, smart parking sensor arrays with ESP32 edge telemetry, and fullstack cloud architectures.
Built custom web applications, Chrome developer extensions (Threadibility), interactive quiz systems, and high-performance client websites using React, Next.js, and PostgreSQL.
Designed micro-controller firmware on ESP32/Arduino, calibrated multi-sensor telemetry (PMS5003, BME280), and developed MQTT communication bridges with cloud databases.

education.description: Focused on Distributed Systems, Network Architecture, Software Engineering, and Internet of Things.
